text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch! That hurts like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But I have to hurry and get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! At times like this, I can just tape up, take some painkillers, and push through!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As long as I tend to my injury properly, I'll be able to keep going!
choice_data_list: Okay, but I'm stopping you if you try anything reckless.
Okay, but I'm stopping you if you try anything reckless.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As long as I tend to my injury properly, I'll be able to keep going!
choice_data_list: Okay, but I'm stopping you if you try anything reckless.
Okay, but I'm stopping you if you try anything reckless.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But… if I just fix the pain, then I can keep running!
choice_data_list: Suppressing the pain won't help your injury heal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you're right… If I just end up making it worse, that will defeat the whole purpose…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Waiting around patiently just isn't in my nature!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay! I promise I won't do anything rash!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's get started right away, then. Umm, is the medical tape in the medicine cabinet?
choice_data_list: Oh, I'll go find it for you!
Oh, I'll go find it for you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeek! Owowow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess takes a tumble and aggravates her injury. Naturally, I tell her to take time off to recover.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer, can I ask you to fetch the tape from the medicine cabinet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Time for some Princess Taping! Pain, pain, go away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew! Now I can get back to strength training no problem!
choice_data_list: You look like you're doing fine!
You look like you're doing fine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Thank you for believing in me and letting me continue my training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I feel like I can overcome any obstacle that stands in my way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As long as I have you by my side, of course.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And on that note, it's time to plunge back into training! Full throttle! But with caution! Let's get lifting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Kawakami Princess is able to overcome her injury and continue her training, taking care not to push herself too hard.
